# CouponDonation

> CouponDonation turns monetary donations into real grocery coupons for verified families in need, partnering with brands like Walmart, Target, and Amazon. 95% of every dollar reaches recipients.

CouponDonation is a US-based giving platform. Donors contribute any amount; funds are converted into $5 and $10 grocery coupons that verified recipient families redeem at major retail partners. Every donation is tracked end-to-end for transparency.
